# Growthbook <> Caju - Intro
Date: 2026-09-04 | Duration: 12m

## Summary
The company plans to consolidate roughly 80–90% of its feature flags from Firebase, self-built solutions, and Growthbook into Growthbook Cloud to reduce complexity, maintenance overhead, and rollout challenges. Cloud deployment is preferred over on-premises because there is no urgent compliance or security requirement, while on-premises would add cost and complexity. The team recommended staying on its discounted legacy Pro plan because enterprise pricing could approach $30,000 per month, including a $10,000 platform fee, and current feature-flag needs are relatively simple. Advanced tiers were considered more valuable for analytics, experimentation, and integrations. Product analytics adoption will remain limited for now because tagging and Databricks meet current needs. Growthbook’s built-in dashboards, SQL reporting, and developing analytics capabilities may be evaluated later as a potential alternative to Amplitude. Dan emphasized transparent, pressure-free guidance, while Fernando supported a gradual “baby steps” approach and plans to revisit expansion as needs grow.

## Keywords
feature flags, Growthbook Cloud, pricing model, A/B testing, product analytics, cost management

## Action Items

**Fernando Dias Belo**
Continue migrating and consolidating feature flags into Growthbook Cloud platform, moving away from Firebase and custom implementations (02:50)
Monitor usage of Growthbook Pro analytics and experimentation features to evaluate if they meet analytics needs before considering other platforms like Amplitude (09:00)
Reach out to Growthbook for guidance or support if future considerations arise regarding upgrading plans, deployment options (cloud vs. on-premises), or expanding usage (10:20)

**Dan Wathne**
Provide guidance and support regarding Growthbook pricing, feature options, and assist client in reassessing needs in future discussions (10:20)
